name: Kaya Castro
source:
Kaya has always stayed within herself and kept everything close to the chest. She’s just trying to get a piece of paper to make enough money to live. She plays a girl who wants to be left alone, and that she is. Outside of someone who’s a bit too thick to read a room.

[In game description]
